name: akira
description: Root dev-convenience scripts for the Akira monorepo. backend/ and frontend/ remain independent npm projects — see CLAUDE.md.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.postinstall: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
